mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that may reduce diclofenac plasma concentrations, while NSAIDs like diclofenac increase seizure risk and may reduce cenobamate efficacy; additionally, both drugs carry hepatotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of cenobamate and consider alternative analgesia; assess liver function tests periodically and counsel on GI/renal protection strategies.
